findings.text: replay_row_policy now passes a claim that always permits instead of no claim, and the two states are not equivalent: reckon/crew/ticker.py:2685 skips a lift end whenever the claim is not None and the group is not in the replay's own lift_groups, which is always true there because replay_row_policy passes none, so a recorded stream whose window begins after the grant loses its lift ends where the previous None printed them; the comment at :2949-2952 claiming no live claim can subtract a row is therefore false for the LIFT_ENDED branch, and no test covers a lift end through the replay.

follower_row_path still resolves its own default claim inline (lift_* → take_lift_claim(session, ...)) while reckon/crew/ticker.py:1795-1799 now performs the same resolution inside PaneRowPath, so the rule for which claim a pane takes without one lives in two places and can drift; the wrapper at crew_follow_commands.py:1190 duplicates what the new default in ticker.py owns, and dropping it would leave one owner.
